tenderSchedule.deptName: Bengaluru Water Supply And Sewerage Board

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and condition as per KW-2
Quoted rates should be excluding GST for all items

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed any civil construction work to an extent of 25% of the cost of the respective works. i.e., Rs.14.57 Lakhs

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in atleast one financial year a minimum turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant).i.e., Rs.58.26 Lakhs

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Reserved Category Certificate SC AND Domical certificate
Assessed Available Tender Capacity AxNx5-B should be greater then the amount put to tender

Providing lowering laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of following diameters glazed stone ware pipes, conforming to IS 651:1992, (with 5th revision) in all respects jointing with EPDM rubber rings (seals according to EN 681 & ASPM 425) The rubber seals joints pipe will have groves in interior of socket and exterior of the spigot. Slope inside to be 1:6 in the concrete towards central drain and finished smooth. Fixing of pipes in CC 1:2:4 with graded metal of 20mm and down size.
